_evidence: 0x005291e8 is the value handler (+0x1a = 0x5291e8 in the image) of exactly seven static items of the menu at 0x84f7xx: 0x84f79c, 0x84f822, 0x84f8a8, 0x84f92e, 0x84f9b4, 0x84fa3a (stride 0x86) and 0x84fb1f, whose static +0xe cell pointers are 0x81d1f2, 0x81d1f3, 0x81d1f4, 0x81d1f5, 0x81d1f6, 0x81d1f7 and 0x81d228 (the only image dwords holding those cell addresses besides code and the 0x66b6dc.. list); the spec's esi set is those items, so 'mov ebx,[esi+0xe]' (0x529216) hits the list head 0x81d1f2, the middle cells, the tail 0x81d1f7 and the extra cell 0x81d228 with static, never-written pointers. Their +0xd (high byte of the u16 id) is 0, so 0x5394b1 -> 0x539a13 stores the low byte of [0xabc080] into the cell unless 'test byte [esi+0x1f],0x20' (0x5394e1) is set; +0x1f is the run-time item flag byte (menu code ors/ands 0x20/0x40, cf. menu_0084300a), varied here at the seven items' +0x1f (0x84f7bb + k*0x86, 0x84fb3e) with bit 0x20 both ways. 0x529219 'mov al,[ebx]' reads the cell; 'cmp al,[ebx-1]; jg' (0x52922b), 'cmp al,[0x81d1f7]; jg' (0x529232), 'cmp al,[ebx+1]; jb' (0x52925f), 'cmp byte [0x81d228],0; je' (0x529266) and 'cmp al,[0x81d228]; jb' (0x52926f) read only the bytes 0x81d1f2..0x81d1f7 and 0x81d228 (0x81d1f2 has no predecessor read, 0x81d1f7's successor is 0x81d228). Plain byte compares, inc/dec and stores: every value is valid; cells and the stored byte draw small menu values with collisions (both sides of each signed jg / unsigned jb, zero successor) plus 0x7f/0x80/0xfe/0xff for the signed compare and the inc/dec wrap. Values are synthetic.
